ucs.title: [LLM] TA505/Indrik Spider SDBbot/Dridex loader: rundll32 from Office or script-host invoking DLL/.dat in user-writable path
ucs.description: Hunts the signature TA505 (Evil Corp / Indrik Spider / DEV-0243) second-stage execution chain — an Office app or Windows script host spawning rundll32.exe to run a DLL or DLL-renamed-as-data file dropped under AppData, ProgramData, Windows\Temp, or Users\Public. This is the exact loader pattern observed for SDBbot/Get2, FlawedAmmyy, Amadey, and Dridex payloads across years of TA505 phishing waves.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("excel.exe","winword.exe","outlook.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powerpnt.exe","explorer.exe") AND (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\Local\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process, "(?i)\.(dll|tmp|dat|db|jpg|png|ocx)[\s,\"']") AND NOT match(user, ".*\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("excel.exe","winword.exe","outlook.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powerpnt.exe","explorer.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\Local\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dll|tmp|dat|db|jpg|png|ocx)[\s,""']"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\rundll32.exe"
| where ParentProcessName has_any (@"\excel.exe", @"\winword.exe", @"\outlook.exe", @"\mshta.exe", @"\wscript.exe", @"\cscript.exe", @"\powerpnt.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\Local\", @"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dll|tmp|dat|db|jpg|png|ocx)[\s,""']"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: TA505/Indrik Spider SDBbot Loader via Rundll32 from User-Writable Path
id: 8f4e9c2a-7b1d-4e5f-9c8a-1d2e3f4a5b6c
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32.exe spawned by an Office app or Windows script host invoking a DLL or DLL-renamed-as-data file in AppData, ProgramData, Windows\Temp, or Users\Public. Signature TA505 / Evil Corp loader pattern across SDBbot/Get2, Amadey, FlawedAmmyy, and Dridex campaigns.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092/
  - https://www.proofpoint.com/us/blog/threat-insight/ta505-distributes-new-sdbbot-remote-access-trojan-with-get2-downloader
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\Local\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Vendor installers occasionally invoke rundll32 against DLLs under ProgramData
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @ParentImage:(*\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\AppData\\Local\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i ParentBaseFileName=/^(excel|winword|outlook|mshta|wscript|cscript|powerpnt|explorer)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(AppData\\\\(Local|Roaming)|ProgramData|Windows\\\\Temp|Users\\\\Public)\\\\", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("\\.(dll|tmp|dat|db|jpg|png|ocx)([\\s,\"']|$)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Locks specifically onto TA505's loader chain — Office/script-host → rundll32 → DLL in user-writable path with export-name comma syntax. The combination (parent set, child=rundll32, AppData/ProgramData/Temp/Public path, and DLL/.dat extension followed by export delimiter) is the documented Get2/SDBbot/Dridex execution shape that TA505 reuses across campaigns. Bare rundll32 abuse is noisy; this spec

ucs.title: [LLM] Clop/TA505 LEMURLOOT webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362 exploit chain)
ucs.description: Detects the post-exploitation file-write that TA505/Clop (GOLD DRAKE, UNC2165) used in the May–June 2023 MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign — IIS w3wp.exe hosting the MOVEit app writing a new .aspx/.ashx into the MOVEit wwwroot. Classic LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) drop that preceded large-scale data theft and extortion.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*" AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ashx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.asp") AND NOT Filesystem.file_name IN ("human.aspx","login.aspx","default.aspx","upload.aspx","logout.aspx","guestaccess.aspx","secmsg.aspx","msggetattach.aspx","filedrop.aspx","machine.aspx","reportprofiles.aspx") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let MoveItWorkers = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEitTransfer","MoveITTransfer","moveit")
    | distinct DeviceId;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where DeviceId in (MoveItWorkers) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MOVEitTransfer","MoveITTransfer","moveit") or FolderPath has @"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\"
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where FolderPath has @"\wwwroot\"
| where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx" or FileName endswith ".asp"
| where FileName !in~ ("human.aspx","login.aspx","default.aspx","upload.aspx","logout.aspx","guestaccess.aspx","secmsg.aspx","msggetattach.aspx","filedrop.aspx","machine.aspx","reportprofiles.aspx")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          FolderPath, FileName, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4663
| where ProcessName endswith @"\w3wp.exe"
| where ObjectName has @"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\" or ObjectName has @"\wwwroot\moveit"
| where ObjectName endswith ".aspx" or ObjectName endswith ".ashx" or ObjectName endswith ".asp"
| where ObjectName !endswith @"\human.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\login.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\default.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\upload.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\guestaccess.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\logout.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\secmsg.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\msggetattach.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\filedrop.aspx"
    and ObjectName !endswith @"\machine.aspx"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ProcessName, ObjectName, AccessMask
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Clop/TA505 LEMURLOOT Webshell Drop on MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362)
id: 6e2d8a1f-3c4b-49e0-bf2a-7a8b9c0d1e2f
status: experimental
description: Detects the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) writing a new .aspx/.ashx file into the MOVEit Transfer wwwroot — the LEMURLOOT webshell drop used by TA505/Clop in the mid-2023 MOVEit mass-exploitation campaign that preceded data theft and extortion against hundreds of organisations.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.initial-access
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.g0092
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.ashx'
      - '.asp'
  filter_legit:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\human.aspx'
      - '\login.aspx'
      - '\default.aspx'
      - '\upload.aspx'
      - '\guestaccess.aspx'
      - '\logout.aspx'
      - '\secmsg.aspx'
      - '\msggetattach.aspx'
      - '\filedrop.aspx'
      - '\machine.aspx'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Authorised MOVEit Transfer patches or upgrades replacing application files (timestamp will correlate with a change window)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE) @TargetFilename:(*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*.aspx OR *\\MoveITTransfer\\wwwroot\\*.aspx OR *\\moveittransfer\\wwwroot\\*.aspx OR *\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*.ashx OR *\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*.asp) -@TargetFilename:(*\\human.aspx OR *\\login.aspx OR *\\default.aspx OR *\\upload.aspx OR *\\guestaccess.aspx OR *\\logout.aspx OR *\\secmsg.aspx OR *\\msggetattach.aspx OR *\\filedrop.aspx OR *\\machine.aspx)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/\\w3wp\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\MOVEitTransfer\\\\wwwroot\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| regex("\\.(aspx|ashx|asp)$", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| NOT TargetFileName=/\\(human|login|default|upload|guestaccess|logout|secmsg|msggetattach|filedrop|machine|reportprofiles)\.aspx$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count(), function=min(_time))
ucs.rationale: Ties directly to the Clop/TA505 MOVEit campaign — only the IIS worker that hosts MOVEit Transfer should ever write to its own wwwroot, and the legitimate .aspx set is fixed and small. Adding the LEMURLOOT / human2.aspx-style drop point (parent=w3wp.exe + path=\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\ + new .aspx not in the vendor allowlist) catches the install step of the exact intrusion chain CISA AA23-158A attri
